events.name: Flamingo Float
events.description: You're lounging on a giant pink flamingo float in a rooftop infinity pool high above the city, eyes on your phone, drifting right to the edge, until a hand reaches in and pushes you back. Thank you, bro.

events.name: Lil Yachty Walkout
events.description: The hardest walk out ever, with your face: you stride out from backstage, throw the mic up and high-step down a long runway into a huge festival crowd.

events.name: Mom Dad Sister Brother
events.description: You flick a little red heart to Mom, Dad and Sister, run out of hearts for Brother, shrug, and give him your own big heart from your chest.

events.name: Parking Lot Karen
events.description: In a sunny shopping-centre car park you lose it over an empty parking space: you jab at it, throw your arms wide, stomp, then march at the phone with a palm up to stop the filming.

events.name: Party Viral Dance
events.description: You sway past a row of clapping guests in a lamp-lit party hall, glide along the line, then jump, kick and spin on the open floor.

events.name: Police Chase
events.description: You're the one on the run: you sprint at the camera through a crowded fruit market, fly over the road onto the roof of a moving red bus, and end up standing on a billboard frame, looking down.

events.name: Somebody That I Used To Know
events.description: You and a friend in front of a flat patchwork wall of pink, cream and grey shapes: you sing the Gotye and Kimbra breakup duet straight to the camera while they sing back to you side-on.
